Sensitize Functions

join_csv_files.Rd

Functions for the sensitizeR package.

Usage

join_csv_files(file1, file2, by)

Arguments

file1

Path to the first CSV file (model input parameters).

file2

Path to the second CSV file (model outputs).

by

The name of the shared key column to join on (character).

Value

A data.frame containing all columns from both files, joined on the shared key.

Details

This file contains core functions for the sensitizeR package. Join Parameter and output CSV Files by a Common Column

Join Model Input and Output CSV Files by a Shared Key

This function takes a CSV (.csv or .txt) file containing model input parameters and a CSV file containing model outputs. The third argument is the shared key column name present in both files. The function returns a dataframe containing all columns from the first file and all columns from the second file, joined on the shared key. If duplicate columns exist (other than the key), they are deduplicated if their data matches; otherwise, the function aborts and notifies the user.

  • Both files must contain the shared key column specified by by.

  • If duplicate columns (other than the key) have different data, the function aborts and returns NULL.

  • Accepts both .csv and .txt files in standard CSV format.

See also

?sensitizeR

Author

WillyRay

Examples

join_csv_files("data1.csv", "data2.csv", "id")
#> Warning: cannot open file 'data1.csv': No such file or directory
#> Error in file(file, "rt"): cannot open the connection
join_csv_files("inputs.txt", "outputs.txt", "run")
#> Warning: cannot open file 'inputs.txt': No such file or directory
#> Error in file(file, "rt"): cannot open the connection
